findings.description: María Concepción Fuenmayor was the daughter of Juan Fuenmayor and Graciliana Fuenmayor.
supporting_sources: Venezuela, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1577-2022 — marriage entry for Eduardo Berrueta and María Tereza Fuenmayor, 13 Jan 1912, naming her parents

findings.description: María Concepción Fuenmayor married Eduardo Berrueta on 13 January 1912 at Maracaibo, Zulia, Venezuela.
supporting_sources: Venezuela, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1577-2022 — marriage entry of 13 Jan 1912
